bugReports.title: Asset Register table causes horizontal viewport overflow on mobile (320px)
bugReports.steps:
1. Open /dashboard on viewport width 320px.
2. Observe page horizontal scroll width exceeding viewport.
bugReports.expected: Table cards stack vertically or table container has dedicated overflow-x: auto wrapper without pushing full page width.
bugReports.resolution: Wrap table in an overflow-x: auto container or use card-based layout on screens < 768px.

bugReports.title: Add Asset form causes horizontal page overflow at 320px
bugReports.steps:
1. Open /dashboard/add-product on viewport width 320px.
2. Observe horizontal scroll on the entire page.
bugReports.expected: Form controls stretch 100% of available container width without extending beyond 100vw.
bugReports.actual: Horizontal page scrolling observed on 320px viewport.
bugReports.resolution: Set form-center grid min-width: 0 and inputs width: 100% with box-sizing: border-box.
